meta.name: wizard
meta.description: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through a manual procedure — third-party setup, a one-off migration, an A→B state transition — opening URLs, capturing values, confirming each step, and writing .env files and GitHub Actions secrets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把手动流程变成交互式向导，自动执行每一步
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要按步骤操作第三方服务或迁移数据
copy.tagline_en: Turn manual procedures into interactive wizards that automate each step
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often follow step-by-step procedures for third-party setup or migration

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成一个交互式 bash 脚本，逐步引导你完成手动流程，如第三方服务配置、一次性迁移或状态转换。脚本会自动打开网页、提示你复制粘贴值、写入 .env 文件和 GitHub Secrets，并显示进度。
howto.when: 当你需要执行一个繁琐的手动流程（如设置第三方服务、运行一次性迁移、或从状态 A 转换到状态 B）时，Claude 会接管并生成向导脚本。

say.text: 帮我创建一个向导，设置 Stripe 支付。
say.note: Claude 会分析仓库，生成逐步脚本。

say.text: 生成一个迁移向导，从旧数据库迁移到新数据库。
say.note: Claude 会定义步骤并生成脚本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates an interactive bash script that walks you through a manual procedure step by step, such as third-party setup, one-off migration, or state transition. The script opens URLs, prompts you to copy values, writes .env files and GitHub Secrets, and shows progress.
howto.when_en: When you need to perform a tedious manual procedure (e.g., setting up a third-party service, running a one-off migration, or transitioning from state A to state B), Claude takes over and generates a wizard script.

say_en.text: Create a wizard to set up Stripe payments.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the repo and generates a step-by-step script.

say_en.text: Generate a migration wizard from old database to new database.
say_en.note: Claude defines stages and produces the script.
